notes: ACCESS: nordstrom.com serves an 'ISTL' JS interstitial (window['istlWasHere']) to every real content route. A 15-profile curl_cffi sweep (chrome107-131, safari15_5-18_0, safari*_ios, edge, firefox) returned the interstitial on all 15; the ISTL-INFINITE-LOOP loop-breaker header returned an empty body; translate.goog proxied the interstitial verbatim; r.jina.ai was itself behind a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge on two attempts. Sitemaps ARE unprotected: https://www.nordstrom.com/navigation-sitemap.xml yielded the complete 73-URL /browse/home nav tree, which is what the category selection below is built from. Counts came from WebFetch, which renders the page past the interstitial and returns the site's own 'N items' header. COUNT VERIFICATION: every count was cross-checked against the page's own highest pagination number. A single page size of 72 reproduces the rendered page count exactly for all 12 categories measured (e.g. 1658 items/24 pages, 7928/111, 2804/39, 945/14, 1474/21, 702/10, 688/10, 538/8, 955/14, 2062/29, 130/2, 129/2) - ceil(total/72) matches in every case, so the headers are exact. Second check: the seven children of Tabletop & Dining sum to 10045 against a parent header of 10237 (1.9% gap, no double counting), which also proves Glassware and Drinkware & Mugs are disjoint populations. EXCLUDED AND WHY: 'Decorative Accents' (7928 items) is dropped as a proven superset roll-up, not a leaf - product IDs 7203921, 8584563, 7895352 and 6138263 on its first page are the identical items on page 1 of Vases & Planters, and 8863828 is the identical item on page 1 of Candle Holders & Accessories; it also carries out-of-scope stock (a 3D gemstone puzzle, a faux magnolia arrangement). 'Candles' (1850 items) dropped as home fragrance - the first 12 titles are all scented (Luxe Jar Candle, Scented Home Candle, Diptyque Baies, Pumpkin Chai) with no unscented child node; 'Diffusers' dropped for the same reason. 'Water Bottles & Tumblers' (339) dropped as a re-cut of Drinkware & Mugs. 'Outdoor Living' (1971) dropped as a cross-department mix whose left nav is filter facets (umbrellas, briefcases, bag accessories) not sub-categories. Also excluded per brief: the entire beauty/fashion/apparel catalogue, Bath, Bedding, Blankets & Throws, Rugs, Decorative Pillows, Table Linens, Accent Furniture, Storage & Organization, Jewelry Boxes & Holders, Desk Accessories & Stationery, Books/Games & Puzzles, Bar Accessories, Flatware, all of Kitchen (appliances, cookware, knives, gadgets), Electronics, Luggage & Travel, Pantry, Pet Accessories, Halloween Decor, Fall Harvest, Dorm Room Essentials, Luxe Home, Housewarming Gifts and New. OVERLAP NOTE: 'Art Prints & Wall Decor' and 'Clocks' share the wall-clock subset (IDs 8584448 and 8350021 appear in both); they are separate named nav categories with distinct scopes (Clocks also holds table/desk/alarm/mantel clocks) so both are kept, but they are not fully disjoint. Mirrors was checked against Art Prints & Wall Decor and the first 15 IDs are disjoint.
